description: Registry of Mendix customers, apps and branches the ACM-Writer agent has worked on. Maps each branch to its on-disk working copy and Mendix version so the parser can be driven without re-sending paths. Maintained by ACM/AI-tools/ACM-Writer.md.

fieldDocs.mendixVersions: Map of installed Mendix version -> on-disk mx.exe location. A branch's mendixVersion looks up its mx.exe here, so the agent never scans the disk for it.
fieldDocs.customers.name: Customer name. Top-level grouping.
fieldDocs.customers.apps.name: App name within the customer.
fieldDocs.customers.apps.storyPrefixes: Ticket prefixes for this app (e.g. SH-2086 -> prefix SH). Used to map a story id to the app.
fieldDocs.customers.apps.branches.name: Git branch name of a specific working copy.
fieldDocs.customers.apps.branches.projectPath: Absolute path to the git working copy folder that contains the .mpr for this branch. Passed to the parser as projectPath. null until recorded.
fieldDocs.customers.apps.branches.knownStoryIds: Story ids seen for this branch (informational).
fieldDocs.customers.apps.branches.mendixVersion: Studio Pro version this branch is built with (key into mendixVersions). null until recorded.
fieldDocs.customers.apps.branches.lastUsed: Date this branch was last driven through the parser (yyyy-MM-dd).
